decision.title: The XSLT API, the XSLT driver's runs and sxml transform (packet )
decision.summary: src/xslt.c implements include/sxml/xslt.h, passing invocation values as invocation globals bound by name; the XSLT driver runs the suite and the CLI gains sxml transform.

body.p: , after , , , , , , , . src/xslt.c implements include/sxml/xslt.h (unchanged), imitating src/xquery.c; no IR kind, no evaluator change, no public header.

item.p: Compile: the principal module is the text or one resolver request (XSLT_MODULE: the reference resolved against the static base URI; XSLT_PACKAGE: name and package-version, "*" for none; XTSE0165 and XTSE3000 when not delivered, XTSE3000 for a principal package that is no xsl:package), read with the static parameters and the default collation (), lowered once as apply-templates in the default mode (every static error of the lowering is found here), its outputs compiled (), a function library over the XSLT parts made, the static parameters retained. The AST is kept: any other invocation (call-template, an initial mode, an initial match selection, a function call) lowers its own unit when a transformation asks (the main function is the invocation, ). On failure an error location names the caller's name for the principal module (the AST that its module URIs borrowed from is gone); collation bindings of the host are not passed (the reader takes only a default collation).

Shared evaluation (accepts 4.10's Proposed item, ): sxml_unit_evaluation gains extension (src/xpath_api_internal.h): a function table for the dynamic context (the XSLT library parts, so function-available and fn:function-lookup see the XSLT functions), the document preparation (strip-space for fn:doc and document(), ) and the result writer; XPath and XQuery pass NULL. Names given as strings still resolve against the unit's static namespaces (per-expression namespaces are left open).

Invocation globals (glossary): the run-time values of an invocation are globals of the unit after the stylesheet's globals and the context global, named Q{urn:x-sxml:invocation}template-parameters, tunnel-parameters (maps from xs:QName, default the empty map; only when the lowering request sets reads_invocation_parameters, which src/xslt.c always does), initial-match-selection and function-arguments (an array; members coerced to the parameter types). src/xslt.c binds them by name like stylesheet parameters, so one mechanism carries everything the host supplies. Apply-templates without a selection or focus is XTDE0044; an initial function that is not visibility="public"/"final" (2.4.5: xsl:stylesheet functions are private) or has no IR function of that arity is XTDE0041.

Prime and run: the global context item is stripped (sxml_xslt_strip_document); static parameters, then the request's stylesheet parameters, then the invocation values are bound by name (XTDE0050 is the initializer's, computed eagerly); a result writer per transformation (temporary output state for a function call) delivers the raw result. Changed in : a result document whose absolute URI is the base output URI (no href) is the principal result, delivered as the request asks (CLI stdout), not to the handler; XTDE1490 when the raw principal result is not empty.

Driver (tests/xslt/driver/xslt_execution.c, 's plan): a budgeted processor per case; the resolver is the QT4 resource table over a never-loaded QT4 "file catalog" with XSLT_MODULE served as XML_DOCUMENT and XSLT_PACKAGE as the matching <package>; params by XPath; no source, initial template or mode means call-template (xsl:initial-template); a serialization assertion without <output> serializes (the bytes parsed back for the other assertions); result documents to the collector, messages to a trace sink. Assertions (sxml_xslt_test_check_assertions): all-of/any-of/not on an explicit stack, assert-message (best over messages) and assert-result-document call the new sxml_qt4_check_assertion_element (the QT4 checks of one element), serialization-matches and assert-serialization on the serialized bytes as an xs:string (assert-serialization: equal after normalize-space, or deep-equal once parsed). Embedded stylesheets are not run. tools/run-xslt.sh (one process per test set, XT40/) and tools/conformance-report.py (XT40: areas by suite group, the twelve core sets, the XSLT slice; the QT4 report's JSON names its program, accepts 4.1's Proposed item).

CLI: sxml transform [--param]... [--initial-template] [--initial-mode] [--method] STYLESHEET [INPUT] (docs/CLI.md); the stylesheet's base URI is file:PATH (the local resolver reads file: relative paths), so includes and fn:doc resolve against the stylesheet; --param values are passed as static parameters too; result documents with an href are not written; messages to stderr. The WebAssembly CLI's size budget is raised to 5,000,000 / 1,100,000 bytes (Proposed).

Fixed on the way: allocation-failure paths in src/xslt_lower_control.c (a double release of the global arrays, arithmetic on NULL) and src/xslt_lower_template.c (allocate_zeroed leaves NULL on failure); the reader passes the XML parser's diagnostic of a module that is not well-formed.

Measured (release, tools/run-xslt.sh, whole suite): in scope 7,585 of 8,728 passed (86.9 %; gate 70 %), 785 failed, 7 errors (memory and step limits: array-022, error-0640a/g, function-1031, json-to-xml-013, result-document-1501/1502), all 274 test sets finished. Core sets: apply-templates 97.4, mode 87.3, match 92.8, for-each-group 90.7, sort 100, key 97.1, number 57.5 (114 in-scope cases need combinations_for_numbering, such as circled digits, which format-integer lacks), choose 95.4, copy 88.4, value-of 53.3, result-document 94.0, function 89.5 %. Top causes: wrong results 460 (assert-xml 148, assert 78), XPST0017 70 (packages, fn:transform, fn:apply-templates, map:for-key, stream-available), XTSE0340 49 (priority patterns), XPST0008/XTSE0650/XTSE0710 around packages (4.16), XPST0051 26 (record and type aliases), XTDE1450 25 (call-template-ext). Not done: function-available and fn:function-lookup of key, accumulator-before/ after and stylesheet functions at run time (they are unit functions of the lowering, not library rows), per-expression namespaces for names given as strings, collation bindings of the host, an implicit package (an xsl:stylesheet) as RESOLVED_PACKAGE (Proposed).
